items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public exposure, security-sensitive releases, monetization expansion, and unsupported claims; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; operations and security sweeps are unavailable; revenue is $4.92 aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution and private launch gates; authorize no spend, monetization expansion, telemetry expansion, or public launch.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for searchwoot.com: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and 4 remain open. Progress evidenced: official API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; draft site terms. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Exact launch decision: keep searchwoot.com private, preview-only, and blocked for public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. For complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net, retain the concrete decision parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched; next action is a dated readiness packet for each covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback, and explicit blockers.

Launch-readiness data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; missing written permission or an API agreement plus field-level limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; the stated measurement-only, consent-gated use is conditionally supportable, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review are missing. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking, remarketing, or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident handling, subpoena process, and data-subject-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.
